_HOW_TO_USE: 1) Copy this file. 2) Name it  My<Form><Number>.json  (MyGhazal26.json, MyNazm1.json, MyRubai1.json …). For poems of OTHER poets: <PoetName><Form><Number>.json (TehzeebHafiNazm1.json) and list the poet once in PoetryConfig.json. 3) Fill in u / h / r (Urdu / Hindi / Roman). 4) Upload. Nothing else to edit — the website lists it, counts it and labels it New/Latest by itself. Delete all the _notes before uploading if you like (they are harmless).
_numbering: Keep numbers continuous per form: MyNazm1, MyNazm2, MyNazm3 … (a missing number ends that form).
_date_note: Optional. The day it was added. Without it, the day you uploaded the file is used.
_poet_note: Optional for your own poems (that name is used). Needed for others only if you want the name spelled/written nicely.
_title_note: Optional. Without it, the first line becomes the title.
_for_a_nazm: For a nazm use the word  "stanzas"  instead of  "couplets" — each stanza can have as many lines as you like (2, 4, 6 …). Everything else is the same.
